capabilities: Edit embedded notes in place with changes saved to the source note
Embed and edit a single header section of a note
Create dynamic embed patterns using date, time, and title variables
Set per-embed height, title visibility, and display name options
Enforce header hierarchy when editing section embeds
disambiguation: Not a file or vault sync tool; 'sync' here means embedded content stays in step with its source note.
extras: Distributed free of charge; the author asks for GitHub stars or contributions as support.
intentEvidence: The missing Notion-style synced block for Obsidian.
problem: Native embeds render as read-only previews, so users must open the source note to edit embedded content and lose keyboard shortcuts there.

relations.evidence: The missing Notion-style synced block for Obsidian.

summary: Turns standard Obsidian embeds into live, two-way synced blocks that are editable in place and write back to the source note.
